lines.1: 「All right, Otome gets nine handicap stones and Yoppi gets three. I'll play both boards at once.」
lines.3: 「Well, I'm freakishly strong at Go too.」
lines.4: 「Hmph. I'll make the Princess's next words, '...I resign.' (That's how you concede a game of Go.)」
lines.9: 「By the way, where are Tsushima and the other boys?」
lines.10: 「Leo has remedial lessons and Subaru has club practice. I think Shinichi went home.」
lines.11: 「Princess, are you listening? One more game.」
lines.21: 「Hm, come to think of it, Leo said something about remedial lessons earlier.」
lines.22: 「Yes. Inori assigned them to him personally...」
lines.23: 「I see. His academic ability still falls short. Perhaps I should tutor him at home as well...」
